ohio-renaissance-festival: The guide warns of grass parking, roadside drainage ditches, variable gravel and wet-weather mud or standing water. These conditions may affect routes differently each day.
The festival’s parking lot is a rolling grass field.
please look out for longer slopes and drainage ditches around the paved roads.
The consistency, size, depth, and compactness of the gravel may be inconsistent through the park and may change day to day or within the day depending on conditions.
Wet weather can lead to soft earth and mud issues. Low lying areas of the park can experience standing water.
The guide describes mostly standing-height food counters, some open containers and no trays. Carrying assistance is not established.

Most of the food counters at the festival are at standing chest level. While some food options do offer clamshell containers for transport, many containers are open-face. There are no trays available.
First aid is described just inside the gate and in Whimsy Woods beside Gryphon’s Nest. If unable to reach a station, ask official polo-shirted staff or at a pub.
There are two first aid stations at the festival. One is located just inside the Front Gate, and the second is in Whimsy Woods next to the Gryphon’s Nest.
If you cannot get to the First Aid station, you can stop one of the Staff members in an official Ohio Renaissance Festival polo. You can also request first aid at any pub location.
The FAQ advertises the 2027 festival on Saturdays, Sundays and Labor Day, September 4–October 31, 10:30 a.m.–7 p.m. This is a future seasonal schedule, not year-round festival opening.
We are open Saturdays, Sundays, and Labor day September 4 – October 31, 2027 from 10:30 am to 7 pm.
Mobile reception may be weak and public Wi-Fi is not offered. The FAQ recommends printing or saving a screenshot of tickets before arrival.
We do not offer wifi at the park and the cell service can often be weak.
Print or take a screenshot of your ticket email before you arrive at the park.
The FAQ prohibits outside food and drink without describing a medical exception. Confirm necessary food or supplies directly before visiting.
Can I bring food and drink into the festival? No. We have a no outside food or drink policy.
The FAQ says severe weather can rarely close the festival; announcements appear on the homepage and social media. Performances may change for safety even when the grounds remain open.
In the rare event we do cancel, look for notice on the homepage and on social media.
The festival operates rain or shine, except in rare cases when severe weather or unsafe conditions beyond our control force us to close.
Our cast and crew work hard to ensure a rainy day is still enjoyable, with some scheduled performances adjusted for safety, if necessary.

Under the festival’s service-animal policy, staff do not provide animal care or supervision. Harnesses, leashes or tethers are required unless disability or task performance prevents their use; the handler must maintain effective control.

Staff are not required to provide care or supervision for your service animal while on grounds. Service animals must be harnessed, leashed, or tethered, unless the individual’s disability prevents using these devices or these devices interfere with the service animal’s safe, effective performance of tasks. Should you not be able to effectively maintain control of your service animal, you will be asked to leave the grounds.

Premium Joust Seating is handicap accessible.

Purchase tickets at the joust field. Buy early in the day before seats are reserved! Look for the Premium Joust Seating sign.
